full_track.tags: K-Indie ballad. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays a fingerstyle pattern with prominent fret noise and percussive slaps on the strings. A soft, dry kick drum provides a steady pulse on every beat. Subdued electric bass follows the root notes of the guitar chords. Male vocals are breathy, intimate, and close-mic'd with minimal reverb. The arrangement is sparse and acoustic-focused. Tempo is 72 BPM in 4/4 time.
